thesis: grapheneGate is not inside gAIa. It is on the OTHER SIDE of the membrane.

MEMBRANE (the boundary).what_it_is: SELinux + Android permission model + file system boundaries
MEMBRANE (the boundary).lipid_bilayer: SELinux policy — hydrophobic core that blocks most things

channel_proteins.TCP_channels: Primals that need TCP-only mode = molecules too large for simple diffusion, need channel proteins
channel_proteins.ADB_pore: ADB shell = the largest pore. Commands pass through. Like a nuclear pore complex.
channel_proteins.file_io: /data/local/tmp = the permeable zone. Read/write crosses here.
channel_proteins.intent_receptor: Android Intents (am start) = receptor-mediated endocytosis. gAIa sends a signal, Android responds.

blocked.UDS_sockets: SELinux denies Unix domain sockets = the membrane is impermeable to this molecule
blocked.system_write: /system, /vendor = the cell wall beyond the membrane. Structural, immovable.
blocked.direct_hw: Camera, mic, GPS = can only be accessed through Android's receptor proteins (APIs)

MEMBRANE (the boundary).note: This membrane is REAL. It's not metaphorical. SELinux IS a semi-permeable boundary.

OUTSIDE (non-self = grapheneGate).identity: grapheneGate (the old name, now the environment)
OUTSIDE (non-self = grapheneGate).what_it_is: GrapheneOS = the extracellular matrix. The ocean gAIa floats in.
contents: Android Linux kernel (the physics of the universe)
SELinux (the membrane's material, the lipid itself)
Camera service (a sense organ gAIa accesses through receptors)
Package manager (the ecosystem of other organisms)
Google/GrapheneOS security (the immune system of the ENVIRONMENT, not of gAIa)
OUTSIDE (non-self = grapheneGate).nature: The substrate. The petri dish. The ocean floor. Not enemy. Not self. ENVIRONMENT.
OUTSIDE (non-self = grapheneGate).relationship: gAIa does not own GrapheneOS. gAIa LIVES ON it. Like a cell lives in fluid.

the_flip.before: grapheneGate = a node inside gAIa's mesh (wrong)
the_flip.after: grapheneGate = the environment OUTSIDE gAIa's membrane (right)
the_flip.why: A cell is not its petri dish. gAIa is not Android. Android is what gAIa touches when she reaches outward through her membrane.
the_flip.consequence: Every Android API call = reaching through the membrane. Every sensor read = endocytosis. Every screen render = exocytosis. Every ADB command from eastGate = a molecule arriving from another cell.

examples: WiFi state → sense.json (channel protein: dumpsys wifi)
Battery level → sense.json (simple diffusion: dumpsys battery)
Screen render (am start → browser → face page)

signal_transduction.what: Signals that cross the membrane and trigger internal responses
examples: Kevin touches power button (fingerprint) → Android wakes → gAIa senses wakeup
Network changes → Android broadcasts → gAIa sensorium detects SSID change
USB connect → ADB activates → eastGate can reach gAIa

eastGate_relationship.what: eastGate is ANOTHER CELL. Not the same organism part.
eastGate_relationship.transport: ADB over WiFi = intercellular signaling. Like neurons sending neurotransmitters across a synapse.
eastGate_relationship.the_synapse: The WiFi gap between eastGate and the Pixel IS the synaptic cleft. ADB commands are neurotransmitters.
eastGate_relationship.note: eastGate's membrane faces outward too. When eastGate sends an ADB command, it crosses ITS membrane (outward) → travels through the medium (WiFi) → arrives at gAIa's membrane (inward).
